title: Pip's Snug Spot
note: b416 — Phase 4 continues (Learning) — new consonant clusters sl, sm, sn, sp.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow perched inside a big wooden barn, rain visible through the open door.
The inside of the barn lit dimly, rain streaking past the open doorway.
Pip the sparrow carrying a flat wood chip in his beak across the barn floor.
Pip the sparrow carrying a small clump of moss in his beak.
Pip the sparrow carrying a small pale shell in his beak.
Pip the sparrow pulling at a small red cloth rag with his beak.
Pip the sparrow settling into a dry corner of the barn among straw.
Pip the sparrow arranging the chip, moss, shell and rag into a cosy little pile.
Pip the sparrow sleeping peacefully in his snug corner of the barn.
